# 2026 Outer Critics Circle Awards

| venue = New York Public Library for the Performing Arts
}}
The 2026 Outer Critics Circle Awards winners are set to be announced on May 11, 2026, recognizing excellence in Broadway and Off-Broadway productions during the 2025–26 season. Nominations were announced on April 21, 2026, with The Lost Boys receiving the most nominations with 11. Mexodus followed with 10 nominations, and Death of a Salesman was the most-nominated play production with 6 nominations.
Winners and nominees
The 2025-2026 Outer Critics Circle Awards nominations were announced on Tuesday, April 21, 2026, by The Pitt cast members Isa Briones (then starring in Just in Time) and Sepideh Moafi. The winners are set to be announced on May 11, 2026, with an awards ceremony on May 27, 2026, at the MMAC Theatre.
